title: 1786 Kangding-Luding earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1786 Kangding-Luding earthquake", at revision 1366163774, opens: "An earthquake occurred on 1 June 1786 in and around Kangding, in what is now China's Sichuan province. It had an estimated magnitude of about 7.75 and a maximum perceived intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. The initial quake killed 435 people. After an aftershock nine days later, a further 100,000 died when a landslide dam collapsed across the Dadu River." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1348781, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Magnitude 7 earthquake (1 June 1786) around Kangding, Sichuan province, China". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
